content.short: Cross-border banking for migrants and international students/workers.
content.description: Zolve is a cross-border neobank that helps global citizens — especially students and professionals moving to the United States, often from India — set up their finances before or as soon as they arrive. Through partner banks, Zolve lets newcomers open a US bank account and get a credit card without a US credit history or social security number, using their home-country profile to underwrite them. It also offers international money transfers, and is expanding into loans and other products that help immigrants build credit and financial footing in a new country. By solving the classic 'no US credit history' barrier that migrants face, Zolve targets internationally mobile students and workers, combining accounts, cards, and credit access into a banking experience designed specifically for people relocating across borders.
content.meta: Zolve offers US bank accounts and credit cards for immigrants and global citizens. Discover Zolve and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
